title: Golden trace case
description: A golden trace case file (section 7.4). Tensors live in a safetensors file next to it: stream_{floor} [positions, 1024] f32 for floor 0..28 (28 is the final stream), k_{floor} and v_{floor} [positions, 8, 128] f16, top_scores [positions, 64] f32, top_ids [positions, 64] i32, and full intermediates at three positions.
